name: clsnbcast
description: CLSNBcast 屏幕共享 - 基于 Agora 与 KOOK 的屏幕共享机器人

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace web
